# CANDIDATE: BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON_MIN_DTE_1

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Testing whether requiring minimum DTE=1 (instead of 0DTE) for the BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup improves fill rates when broker response is unreliable for ultra-short expirations. The hypothesis is that longer-dated options offer tighter bid-ask spreads and higher liquidity, reducing slippage and improving execution quality while preserving the same directional edge. This isolates the DTE variable while keeping trigger conditions, exit logic, and position sizing identical.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger unchanged: requires ≥2 of 3 simultaneous conditions - (1) level reclaim (SPY tests defined support and prints reversal candle with wide range, open low, close near high, volume ≥1.5× recent average), (2) EMA ribbon flip from bearish-stack to bullish-stack on 3-min timeframe, (3) confluence with multi-day or premarket structure (ascending trendline, premarket low, prior day low, or multi-day swing low aligning at same level). Contract selection changes: select ATM or 1st OTM call with earliest expiration meeting DTE≥1 (typically next-day expiry) instead of 0DTE. Exit logic unchanged: chart stop (primary invalidation: SPY closes 3-min candle below reclaimed level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (arms at +5%, trails 0.15 off HWM), premium stop as catastrophe cap only (−50% Safe), TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3 contracts), runner exits on re-entry into EMA ribbon, rejection signature, or premium ≥3× entry, with time stop at 15:50 ET.
